title: Trim SDK internals and unused public surface, release 0.4.0
description: Apply the trimming audit: remove unused public API, JSON config, user module, cache index, global state; add public session API; delete live integration scripts; fix docs; bump to 0.4.0 and uv publish. Spec: docs/specs/sdk-trim-0.4.md. Only consumer is addictune-cli; its used surface must remain intact.

title: Use human display names in Network.name
description: Change built-in Network.name values to spaced display form: DI.FM, RadioTunes, Rock Radio, Jazz Radio, Classical Radio, Zen Radio. Lets the CLI drop STATION_NAMES. No new field.
acceptance_criteria: Network.name values updated; tests updated; all tests pass.

title: Add stream URL helper that injects the client's listen key
description: CLI hand-rolls listen_key injection (handlers/playlists.py url.replace, playback_bar._with_listen_key, services/playback.py passing client.listen_key). Expose on ChannelsAPI a method that uses the owning Client's listen_key so callers never touch the key. Keep get_stream_url/resolve_stream_url signatures stable for existing callers or make listen_key optional defaulting to client's key.
acceptance_criteria: ChannelsAPI.get_stream_url / resolve_stream_url work with listen_key omitted (uses Client.listen_key); unit tests cover default and explicit key; all tests pass.

title: Type list[dict] fields on ShowEpisode/PlaylistTracks/MixShow
description: Deferred owner decision: type ShowEpisode.tracks, PlaylistTracks.tracks/last_tracks, MixShow.artists instead of list[dict]. CLI reads episode.tracks[0]["id"] and iterates content.tracks as dicts, so this needs a coordinated CLI change. Not part of 0.4.0.
notes: Promoted into 0.4.0 epic per 06-sdk Phase A. Fixture shapes: show_episodes tracks {id,title}; playlist_content tracks {artists,content,display_artist,display_title,id,images,length,mix,title}; mixshow artists {id,name,slug}. Breaking for CLI dict access — CLI follow-up.

title: Release 0.4.0: bump, lock, build, publish
description: Bump pyproject version to 0.4.0, uv lock, uv build, verify wheel contents, uv publish (requires UV_PUBLISH_TOKEN or trusted publishing). Only after epic review APPROVE and push.
notes: Also: add a one-line versioning policy to README (semver; breaking changes bump minor while <1.0) and create git tag v0.4.0.

title: Remove user API module and models
description: Delete api/user.py, models/user.py, tests/unit/test_user.py, fixtures ping/payment_method/premium_status, Client.user attribute, exports Ping/PaymentMethod/PaymentType/PremiumStatus/UserAPI, README 'User' section. Breaking; unused by addictune-cli.

title: Remove unused API methods and their models/tests
description: Remove methods unused by any consumer: channels.add_listen_history/get_listen_history/get_favorite; playlists.get_featured/get_by_id/get_listen_history; tracks.get_qualities/get_preferred_quality/set_preferred_quality; AuthAPI.login mode= parameter (keep session mode only); ChannelsAPI stream_qualities/public_client fallback params. Remove now-unused models (ListenHistoryEntry, PlaylistListenHistoryEntry, AudioQuality*, CurrentAudioQuality — verify each is unreferenced), fixtures, conftest fixtures, exports, tests, README lines. Breaking.

title: Remove AddictuneClient alias
description: Remove AddictuneClient = Client alias (client.py), its export in __init__.py/__all__, and test_addictune_client_is_alias_for_client. Breaking: addictune-cli handlers/auth.py imports it for type hints — CLI follow-up must switch to Client.

title: Remove JSON config loading and auto-discovery
description: config.py: remove from_json/to_json/to_dict/_from_dict/_default_config_paths/load_config and json/os imports. Remove load_config export from __init__.py. Remove README 'JSON config file', 'Auto-discovery' sections and references; drop 'Zero-config' JSON claim in Features. Remove related test_client tests. Breaking.

title: Add public per-network session API on Client
description: Additive: Client.login(email, password, network: str | None = None) stores session for given network (default config.network) and listen key; Client.set_session(slug, session_key, listen_key=None) for restoring persisted sessions; Client.has_session(slug) -> bool. Lets addictune-cli stop mutating _session_keys/_credentials/_listen_key. Tests in test_client.py. README auth section updated.
notes: Also: AuthAPI.login must raise AddictuneAuthError on 422 from /member_sessions (bad credentials), so the CLI drops its {401,403,419,422} set.
close_reason: Client.login(network=), set_session, has_session; 422 -> AddictuneAuthError; 180 tests pass

title: Transport: trim RetryTransport, drop CircuitConfig.name
description: transport.py: remove _send request rebuild (pass request directly after aread), inline redundant logging; remove unused CircuitConfig.name. Keep RetryConfig/CircuitConfig semantics (max_attempts, backoff, breaker threshold/recovery).

title: Cache: drop item index and global TTL; unify ETag helper
description: cache.py: remove index_list/get_indexed (and id_field/index_key params in _helpers and callers), remove set_default_ttl/resolve_ttl and the module-global TTL mutated by Client.__init__ (client.py:90); TTL fallback becomes a module constant applied in set_etag when server TTL is None. Remove AddictuneConfig.default_cache_ttl. _helpers.py: collapse the three ETag read/write paths (cached_get_list, cached_get_object, _fetch_page) into one shared conditional-GET helper; drop redundant `if params` branches. Prune test_helpers cache-index tests and get_indexed patches in other tests. Keep cache.get_etag/set_etag names (tests patch them).
close_reason: Cache index/global TTL removed; single _conditional_get helper; 175 tests pass

title: Simplify headers.py aliases and Network listen_host validator
description: headers.py: replace normalize_keys model_validator with validation_alias on fields (response header keys are lowercase). models/network.py: derive listen_host without object.__setattr__ (before-validator). No public behavior change. (_helpers ETag merge moved to sdk-nfo, where index removal makes it clean.)

title: Docs accuracy and export dedupe
description: README: fix dependency claim (platformdirs is a dependency), reflect removed APIs, session API. __init__.py: re-export models via `from .models import *`-free dedupe (import names once; build __all__ from models.__all__). CONTRIBUTING: keep accurate. Re-measure LOC and record in spec.

title: Delete live integration scripts
description: tests/integration/* are live credential-requiring scripts not collected by pytest (sys.path hack, from session import). Delete the directory and .gitignore entry for tests/integration/.session_cache.json; update CONTRIBUTING 'Running tests' if it references them.
